name: vscode-winccoa-debugger
description: Debug Adapter for WinCC OA CTRL scripts
author: winccoa-tools-pack

script.description: Path to the CTRL script to debug. When set, a temporary WCCOActrl manager is started automatically and removed after the session.

scriptManagerNum.description: Manager number (-num) for the auto-started script manager.

host.description: Host where WinCC OA is running

project.description: WinCC OA project name used for the -proj connection argument (e.g. 'DevEnv3.21'). When omitted, 'system' is used as fallback.

system.description: WinCC OA system name used as DP prefix (e.g. 'System1:'). Use empty string for single-system projects.

pathMappings.description: Path mappings from local to remote

adapterManagerNumber.description: Manager number the debug adapter itself registers with in WinCC OA. Must not collide with existing managers in the project.

adapterPort.description: TCP port the debug adapter listens on. Auto-injected (default: 7474) — normally no need to change.

host.description: Host where WinCC OA is running

project.description: WinCC OA project name used for the -proj connection argument (e.g. 'DevEnv3.21'). When omitted, 'system' is used as fallback.

system.description: WinCC OA system name used as DP prefix (e.g. 'System1:'). Use empty string for single-system projects.

pathMappings.description: Path mappings from local to remote

adapterManagerNumber.description: Manager number the debug adapter itself registers with in WinCC OA. Must not collide with existing managers in the project.

adapterPort.description: TCP port the debug adapter listens on. Auto-injected (default: 7474) — normally no need to change.

configurationSnippets.label: WinCC OA: Debug CTRL Script
configurationSnippets.description: Launch and debug the active CTRL script (auto-starts a temporary manager)

configurationSnippets.label: WinCC OA: Attach to Manager
configurationSnippets.description: Attach to a running WinCC OA manager

winccoa.debugger.adapterCliPath.description: Absolute path to the debug adapter cli.js. Used as fallback when the bundled adapter is not found (e.g. during development). Example: /home/user/npm-winccoa-repos/npm-winccoa-debugger/dist/cjs/cli.js

winccoa.debugger.bootstrapPath.description: Absolute path to the WinCC OA bootstrap.js. Required to start the debug adapter with pmon authentication.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run adapter:fetch && npm run compile:extension
scripts.compile: npm run adapter:fetch && npm run compile:extension
scripts.clean:out-tests: node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('out/test',{ recursive:true, force:true, maxRetries:10, retryDelay:200 })}catch(e){console.warn('clean:out-tests skipped:', e.message)}"
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile:tsc && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerE2eTests
scripts.test:e2e:setup: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerSetupE2e
scripts.test:e2e:bpcycle: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerBpCycleE2e
scripts.test:e2e:step: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerStepCommandsE2e
scripts.test:e2e:libbp: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerLibraryBpE2e
scripts.test:e2e:soe: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerStopOnEntryE2e
scripts.test:e2e:spuriousstops: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerSpuriousStopsE2e
scripts.test:e2e:racecondition: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerRaceConditionE2e
scripts.test:e2e:variables: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerVariablesE2e
scripts.test:e2e:lifecycle: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerLifecycleE2e
scripts.test:e2e:quickdebug: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerQuickDebugE2e
scripts.test:e2e:full: npm run compile:tsc && npm run setup:e2e-links && vscode-test --label debuggerBpCycleE2e && vscode-test --label debuggerStepCommandsE2e && vscode-test --label debuggerLibraryBpE2e && vscode-test --label debuggerStopOnEntryE2e && vscode-test --label debuggerSpuriousStopsE2e && vscode-test --label debuggerRaceConditionE2e
scripts.test:unit:coverage: npm run compile:tsc && npm run clean:coverage:unitTests && vscode-test --label unitTests --coverage --coverage-output coverage/unitTests --coverage-reporter lcov --coverage-reporter html --coverage-reporter json-summary --coverage-reporter text-summary
scripts.test:integration:coverage: npm run compile:tsc && npm run clean:coverage:integrationTests && vscode-test --label integrationTests --coverage --coverage-output coverage/integrationTests --coverage-reporter lcov --coverage-reporter html --coverage-reporter json-summary --coverage-reporter text-summary
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:integration:coverage
scripts.ci:integration: npm ci && npm run compile && npm run test:integration
scripts.style-check: npm run format:check && npm run lint
